family-wall-unit.alt: The black-and-white portrait wall at Originals Los Angeles, rebuilt flat from the store's own photos
family-wall-unit.source: Rebuilt flat from the business's own Google Maps 'By owner' photos of the LA store; no AI, no generative or inpainted pixels. la-13 is the base (99.7% of pixels); la-photo-b and la-317 fill where a prop hid the wall; la-50, la-318, la-315, la-304, la-164, la-251, la-70 and la-243 were registered and tried. Method: rectified with vanishing points and the wall's own repeat shift; the three print panels registered per repeat (SIFT/RANSAC + optical flow); letters, props, plants, cases, tree, balloons and neon masked; tone-matched, fused, graded to crisp black and white. One true horizontal repeat (P = 3069 px at master scale). Coverage: 100% real photo pixels, 0 holes; cropped to the top 62.4% of the wall height because the lower rows stand behind the letters in every photo; no print substituted; a thin dark seam sits on the tile edge (a print border).
